DiamondSignals Intelligence

Glossary

I. Global System Metrics

Slate Heat
A model-driven index of total opportunity across the day's schedule.
System Status
Confirms the live state of the Statcast-driven pipeline.
Edge Score
A 0 to 100 ranking summarizing signal strength versus baseline.

II. Pitching Signal Terms

Whiff %
Share of recent pitches that generated a swinging strike event.
FB Velo
Average recent fastball velocity.
Extension
Release extension in feet.

III. Hitting Signal Terms

Avg EV
Mean exit velocity on tracked batted-ball events.
Barrel-like %
Share of batted balls in the DiamondSignals barrel-like bucket.
EV Burst
A recent jump in average exit velocity versus baseline.
